about_the_game:
Only The Wurst is a chaotic first-person party game where you and up to 11 other players compete in an onslaught of non-stop 60 second minigames with no breaks in-between. Each minigame has a completely unique setting, gameplay loop, and artistic direction; with the only thing in common between them being an extreme dedication to over-the-top gib splattering violence!

POINTS MODE

When playing in 'Points' mode, every player's performance in each minigame will be evaluated and earn them points for the round. After a fixed number of minigames have been completed, the player with the most points wins and is rewarded handsomely!

ELIMINATION MODE

When playing in 'Elimination' mode, a poor performance in a minigame will cost you. The bottom-ranking player at the end of each game will be eliminated, and the games will continue taking one victim at a time until only one player remains.

SURVIVAL MODE

When playing in 'Survival' mode, your performance is no longer considered. You and your enemies will cycle through endless minigames until only one person is still alive to be crowned the winner. No respawns, no points, no mercy.

GAME RULE MODIFICATIONS

The game's rules are entirely customizable, we want you to play the game in the way you think is the most fun! And if you don't care about the game's 50+ achievements and cosmetics to unlock, then you can also have that fun using the built-in support for completely breaking the game with cheats!

CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION

The customization options don't stop at just the rules, though! Earning points, killing other players, winning matches, completing challenges, and finding secrets can unlock you a variety of cosmetics to personalize yourself with. No microtransactions in sight, show off your achievements by proving you worked hard to earn them!

SECRETS AND EASTER EGGS

Taking a backseat to the chaos of the game loop is a variety of secrets to be uncovered hidden throughout the game! Put your heads together and follow the clues to discover the answers to questions you may not have thought to ask, and earn hidden cosmetics while you do it!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains over the top cartoon violence and gore. Not recommended for children.
